SPORT WAGON
Sport in more than just name, the TSX Sport Wagon earns its badge with its driver-focused cockpit, highly efficient engine and precise response. And if your idea of sport includes
more than taking on a challenging stretch of asphalt, the TSX Sport Wagon offers plenty of cargo space for your gear. Its class-leading 30-mpg highway rating1 also adds to the
vehicle’s performance credentials.

Owner Benefits
When you purchase a vehicle with the exceptional quality and reliability of Total Luxury Care® (TLC®)13 As an Acura owner, you’ll enjoy services like
an Acura, you expect service and support to be of the same caliber. After all, Trip-Interruption benefits, a 24-hour Roadside Assistance program and Acura
a premium automobile is only part of the ownership experience. With Acura, Concierge™, which offers help in an emergency or when you’re planning a trip.
you also get a commitment. To personalized care. To attentive service.

PERFORMANCE SPECIAL EDITION (Adds to or replaces standard TSX 4-cylinder sedan features)
• 201-hp, 2.4-liter, 16-valve, DOHC i-VTEC® 4-cylinder engine • Aggressive front corner spoilers, unique rear bumper fascia and side sills
• 280-hp, 3.5-liter, 24-valve, SOHC VTEC® V-6 engine (V-6 Sedan) • Unique color for 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels
• 5-speed automatic transmission with Sequential SportShift paddle shifters • Available 5-speed automatic or close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission
• Close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission (available Special Edition only) • Exclusive ebony Lux Suede®- trimmed interior with red accents
• Front-wheel drive • Red contrast stitching on seats, steering wheel, shifter and armrest
• 4-wheel independent suspension: double wishbone front / multi-link rear • Red instrument illumination and ambient cabin lighting
• Electric variable power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering (EPS) • Silver-colored Sequential SportShift paddle shifters
• 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels with P225/50 R17 93V high-performance • Aluminum sport pedals
all-season tires (Sedan & Sport Wagon) • Ebony headliner
• 18-inch aluminum-alloy wheels with P235/45 R18 94V high-performance
all-season tires (V-6 Sedan) TECHNOLOGY PACKAGE (Adds to or replaces standard features)
• Acura Navigation System with Voice Recognition™ and rearview camera
STANDARD TSX FEATURES • Acura/ELS Surround® 415-watt Premium Audio System (Sport Wagon,
• Dual-zone automatic climate control system with air filtration 460 watts) with 10 speakers, hard disk drive (HDD) media storage,
• Remote entry system with folding key and Acura personalized settings in-dash CD, DVD-Audio player and Dolby® Pro Logic® II
• Bluetooth® HandsFreeLink® wireless telephone interface3 • AcuraLink Real-Time Traffic and Weather™4
• Active Sound Control (V-6 Sedan) • Traffic Rerouting™4
• Tilt and telescopic steering column • GPS-linked, solar-sensing, dual-zone automatic climate control system
• Retractable cargo area cover (Sport Wagon) • Song By Voice®
• Sport seats with perforated leather-trimmed interior and contrast stitching • Remote-linked, power-operated tailgate (Sport Wagon)
• Driver’s and front passenger’s heated, power-adjustable seats
